open_loop: He's Manchester United's captain and England's player of the year. He criticised his manager on TV, and four days later he was on the bench. What happened next?

beats.fact: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes criticised Michael Carrick's tactics after a 4-1 Champions League defeat at Como, and four days later Carrick left him on the bench for the 3-0 Premier League defeat by Bournemouth at Old Trafford. He did not come on.
Fernandes has been Manchester United's permanent captain since 2023. Last season he set the Premier League record for most assists in a season and was named PFA and FWA Player of the Year.

numbers.awards: PFA + FWA Player of the Year (last season)
numbers.record: most assists in a Premier League season

beats.fact: After the 4-1 defeat at Como in October 2026, Fernandes said on TV that not pressing man-to-man was the staff's decision, and when asked whether the tactics were to blame said that was for the manager and staff to judge, not him. Carrick called dropping him a 'pure football' decision.
beats.quote: It's a decision from the staff to not press man-to-man

beats.fact: Instead of fighting the decision, Fernandes inspired a 3-2 Champions League comeback win over Roma from 2-0 down, then said Carrick had been right to drop him.
beats.quote: Everyone thought that was a punishment for the words that I had. If it was, it was right. The manager is the one who makes the decisions.

beats.fact: Carrick was sacked on 12 November 2026 with United in the Premier League relegation zone (United's worst start to a season since 1986). New head coach Mauricio Pochettino confirmed Fernandes stays captain. Fernandes says United have offered him a new contract but it is 'not the right time' to talk, and that he has always chosen to stay.
beats.quote: If I wanted more money, I wouldn't be here.
